title: Audit Terra-Infirmary
html:
Quest Giver: Soldier Kwale

Quest Type: Collect

Quest Description: Collect 20 Thermometers from enemies in Algor's Terror Dome.

Quest Reward: 1250 Gold and 1 King's Coin

Return to: Soldier Kwale

Repeatable: Yes

Following Quest: None

Last Build Updated: 155

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Collect 20 Thermometers from the Creatures in Algor's Terror-Dome and Report to Soldier Kwale in Algor's Terror-Dome Base Camp.

Offer:

It looks like the dungeon really is suffering from a fever. The results we got back were definitive, so now all we can do is monitor the temperature of the creatures to make sure it is not getting worse. All I need you to do is go into the dungeon and grab some samples from any of the creatures in Algor's Terror-Dome. This way we can get a wide sampling and make sure that things are getting better and not worse.

Head into Algor's Terror-Dome and collect Thermometers from any of the creatures and return to me, Soldier Kwale, here in Algor's Terror-Dome Base Camp.

Turn-in:

Hand me the Thermometers, please. I'll seal these and send them off. Here is your reward and let me know when you are ready to collect more.

Objectives:

  • Thermometers ×20

Level range: 10–25
